investigation_notes.Alert Name: Microsoft Defender: Potentially Unwanted Application Prevented
investigation_notes.Description: Microsoft Defender prevented a PUA detection identified as PUA:MacOS/MacKeeper on the Windows host WKSTN-DEV-772. The file was a Gradle cache lock file that was accessed by java.exe launched from idea64.exe, indicating user-driven development activity. The detection was blocked (remediation_status is 'prevented') and the signature references MacKeeper, which targets macOS and is unlikely to represent an active Windows infection, so this alert is assessed as Low Priority.
